instruction: Configure the spreadsheet for landscape orientation and export it to PDF ensuring all content fits on a single page.

metadata.explanation: Task requires configuring landscape orientation and exporting to PDF with all content on one page. Evaluator checks PDF orientation (landscape) and page count (1). Similar to original task but specifically tests orientation configuration.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator checks both landscape orientation and single-page requirement, covering all instruction requirements
Correct getter logic: Extracts PDF orientation by comparing width vs height (landscape if width > height), which is semantically correct
Correct metric logic: Compares both orientation and page count with appropriate partial credit (50% each)
Proper expected parameter handling: Metric correctly accesses rules dictionary directly via expected.get() since expected.type='rule' means get_rule returns config['rules']
Good edge case handling: Returns 0.0 for missing/invalid PDFs or empty PDFs
Correct expected values: orientation='landscape' and page_count=1 match instruction requirements
Proper data flow: Getter extracts {orientation, page_count} dict, metric compares these exact fields
